verdict.rationale: Postman documents unattended collection runs through the Postman CLI and API in CI/CD pipelines (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19), and it mentions building automation into workflows and a visual workflow tool (postman-docs-30, postman-docs-37). However, the background scheduling and triggering come from the external CI system, and Agent Mode is shown only as an interactive, natural-language assistant (postman-docs-8). missing for 10: first-party scheduled or background automations (e.g. scheduled runs or monitors), evidence of agents acting autonomously without a user prompt, trigger/event-driven automation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
